headline: The ECB will facilitate access to euro "swap" lines: Lagarde
summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde said the central bank will make its euro swap lines with other countries more accessible. The aim is to shield the euro area from external financial shocks and promote the euro's international role.
why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, and swap lines are central-bank funding arrangements used during market stress. Changes to them affect euro liquidity and the currency's global standing.
original_headline: El BCE facilitará el acceso a las líneas de "swap" en euros: Lagarde
